nodes.description: Privileged owner address set in constructor from msg.sender; gates admin functions.
Public mapping of token balances; mutated by transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Mapping marking addresses as whitelisted for selling; set in _mints.
Maximum number of sales per address, set by init and read by condition.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Minimum sale amount, configured by init and read by condition.
Maximum sale amount, configured by init and read by condition.
Whitelisted trading address set by setTradeAddress and read by ensure.
Total token supply assigned in constructor.
Constant token decimals (18) used for scaling in init and _mints.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address used as privileged spender and in ensure.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as sender.
Internal view gate that whitelists owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale and otherwise enforces condition.
Core public payable transfer logic; debits allowance and balances, increments _onSaleNum.
Public payable approval writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view enforcing sale number, min and max sale constraints.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address and payload.
Whitelisted minting function that overwrites balanceOf[spender] and sets canSale.
Owner-only configuration of sale limits and sale count.
Owner-only batch distribution of tokens to a list of recipients in a loop.
Owner-only setter for the whitelisted tradeAddress.
Internal pure Uniswap V2 pair address derivation using create2 hashing.
Constructor setting name, symbol, supply, owner and initial allowance to UNI router.
SafeERC20 helper performing a low-level call to a token and decoding the optional boolean.
Attacker-controlled caller address used for authorization, allowance and balance operations.
a.delegatecall(b) executing arbitrary untrusted code in contract storage context.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value without SafeMath.
Unchecked total = _value * _tos.length multiplication that can overflow.
address(token).call(data) low-level call to an external ERC20 contract.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath.
Unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
Parameter _from of transferFrom (debit source address).
Parameter _to of transferFrom (credit destination address).
Parameter _value of transferFrom (amount moved).
Parameter _spender of approve (allowance grantee).
Parameter _value of approve (allowance amount).
Parameter a of delegate (delegatecall target address).
Parameter b of delegate (delegatecall calldata payload).
Parameter spender of _mints (mint recipient).
Parameter addedValue of _mints (minted amount).
Parameter saleNum of init (per-address sale cap).
Parameter token of init (minimum sale amount).
Parameter maxToken of init (maximum sale amount).
Parameter _tos of batchSend (recipient list).
Parameter _value of batchSend (amount per recipient).
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress (new whitelisted trade address).
Local variable total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Parameter factory of pairFor (Uniswap factory address).
Parameter tokenA of pairFor.
Parameter tokenB of pairFor.
Local variable pair computed in pairFor.
Parameter _from of condition (address whose sale count is checked).
Parameter _value of condition (amount checked against min/max sale).
Parameter _from of ensure (checked against whitelist).
Parameter _to of ensure (checked against owner).
Parameter _value of ensure (forwarded to condition).

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from sender into transferFrom.
transferFrom uses msg.sender for allowance debit and balance authorization.
approve writes the allowance slot of msg.sender.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before delegatecall.
_mints authorizes msg.sender against owner and hardcoded addresses.
init requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
constructor assigns owner from msg.sender and mints supply to it.
transfer directly invokes transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom enforces require(ensure(_from, _to, _value)).
ensure calls condition for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure derives the Uniswap pair address via pairFor.
delegate executes a.delegatecall(b) with attacker-supplied target and data.
callOptionalReturn performs address(token).call(data).
External low-level token call can re-enter transferFrom before state settles.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value underflows without SafeMath.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value underflows without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_to] += _value can overflow without SafeMath.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue * 10**decimals.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true.
init writes _saleNum.
init writes _minSale scaled by decimals.
init writes _maxSale scaled by decimals.
setTradeAddress writes tradeAddress.
condition reads _saleNum to gate selling.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition compares _value against _minSale.
condition compares _value against _maxSale.
ensure whitelists _from == tradeAddress.
ensure compares _from against the UNI router constant.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor sets balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
constructor grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply argument.
batchSend reads and writes balanceOf for sender and recipients.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
batchSend adds _value to balanceOf[_to] in an unbounded loop.
_from parameter flows into balance and whitelist checks of transferFrom.
_to parameter flows into balance credit of transferFrom.
_value parameter flows into allowance and balance arithmetic of transferFrom.
_spender parameter is the allowance grantee in approve.
_value parameter is the allowance amount in approve.
a parameter is the arbitrary delegatecall target in delegate.
b parameter is the arbitrary delegatecall payload consumed by delegatecall_arbitrary.
spender parameter is written into balanceOf and canSale in _mints.
addedValue parameter becomes balanceOf[spender] in _mints.
saleNum parameter is assigned to _saleNum in init.
token parameter is scaled into _minSale in init.
maxToken parameter is scaled into _maxSale in init.
_tos parameter is iterated as recipients in batchSend.
_value parameter is the per-recipient amount in batchSend.
addr parameter is assigned to tradeAddress.
local total feeds the unchecked multiplication node.
factory parameter is hashed in pairFor.
tokenA parameter is sorted and hashed in pairFor.
tokenB parameter is sorted and hashed in pairFor.
local pair is the create2-derived return value of pairFor.
_from parameter is used to read _onSaleNum in condition.
_value parameter is compared to min/max sale in condition.
_from parameter is matched against owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale in ensure.
_to parameter is matched against owner in ensure.
_value parameter is forwarded to condition from ensure.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from is a transient input of transferFrom and carries no standalone semantics.
Parameter _to is a transient input of transferFrom and carries no standalone semantics.
Parameter _value is a transient input of transferFrom and carries no standalone semantics.
Parameter _spender only exists as an argument of approve.
Parameter _value of approve is local to that function.
Parameter a exists only as the delegatecall target inside delegate.
Parameter b is the calldata payload consumed by the delegatecall_arbitrary operation.
Parameter spender is used only inside _mints.
Parameter addedValue is used only inside _mints.
Parameter saleNum is consumed by init.
Parameter token is consumed by init.
Parameter maxToken is consumed by init.
Parameter _tos is iterated only inside batchSend.
Parameter _value is distributed only inside batchSend.
Parameter addr is assigned only inside setTradeAddress.
Local total is the intermediate value of the unsafe multiplication total = _value * _tos.length.
Parameter factory is hashed only inside pairFor.
Parameter tokenA is used only inside pairFor.
Parameter tokenB is used only inside pairFor.
Local pair is the computed return value of pairFor.
Parameter _from is only read to index _onSaleNum inside condition.
Parameter _value is only compared against _minSale/_maxSale inside condition.
Parameter _from is only checked against the whitelist inside ensure.
Parameter _to is only checked against owner inside ensure.
Parameter _value is only forwarded to condition inside ensure.
